title: Exchanges & returns
intro: If something is not right, talk to us first.

sections.title: Exchanges
sections.text: We offer a 7-day exchange for size issues and defects. Contact us by WhatsApp or email with your order number and a clear photo.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.text: Refund requests are answered individually. Please contact us and wait for our reply before sending an item back.

sections.title: Pre-orders
sections.text: Pre-order pieces are ordered especially for you. Ask us about their exchange terms before you confirm.
